content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Faculty members are entitled to Dearness Allowance, Transport Allowance, and other allowances applicable to Central Government Employees. NIT Warangal provides a residential campus with suitable accommodation subject to availability, or House Rent Allowance otherwise. Other benefits include Reimbursement of Children Education Allowance, Reimbursement of Medical expenses including cashless treatment at Warangal and Hyderabad, Leave Travel Concession (LTC), National Pension Scheme (unless governed by CCS Pension Rules), Cumulative Professional Development Allowance (CPDA) amounting to Rs. 3 lakh, and an initial research seed grant of Rs. 5 lakh for newly recruited faculty members.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIT Warangal Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the online recruitment portal at NIT Warangal Recruitment Portal . Register and log in to fill out the application form in one or multiple sessions. Upload scanned copies of required documents, category certificates, research statements, and teaching statements along with claimed credit points. Pay the non-refundable application fee online depending on your category. Submit the application form online before 30 November 2026, 11:59 PM IST. Keep a printed or digital copy of the submitted application form for future reference.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Matriculation / 10th Standard or equivalent certificate as Age Proof. Higher Secondary / Class XII (or equivalent) board marksheet. Degree certificates of UG and PG along with marksheets for all academic years. Ph.D. degree or Provisional Certificate or Notification of Ph.D. award. Category Certificate (SC/ST, OBC-NCL issued on or after 1 April 2026, EWS Income and Asset Certificate for Financial Year 2026–2027) in Government of India format, if applicable. Disability / Medical certificate with UDID certificate, if applicable. Photo Identity Card issued by a Government agency or last attended institution. Experience Certificate(s) from the Head(s) of Organization(s) indicating Pay Level, Basic Pay, duration, and duties. Research Statement and Teaching Statement. No Objection Certificate (NOC) for employed candidates at the time of presentation or interview.

faq.question: Q1. What is NIT Warangal Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: NIT Warangal Faculty Recruitment 2026 is an employment notification (NITW/FR-2/2026) issued by the National Institute of Technology Warangal to fill 34 faculty positions across various departments at different pay levels.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 34 vacancies are available, comprising 1 for Professor, 3 for Associate Professor, 6 for Assistant Professor Grade I, and 24 for Assistant Professor Grade II.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the online application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 30 November 2026 up to 11:59 PM IST.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. in the respective discipline with First Class in preceding degrees (UG and PG, or direct Ph.D. after BE/B.Tech with First Class at the Bachelor's level).

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for Unreserved, OBC-NCL, and EWS candidates?
faq.answer: The non-refundable application fee is ₹2000 for Unreserved, OBC-NCL, and EWS candidates, ₹1000 for SC/ST/PwD candidates, and $50 for Indian citizens applying from abroad.

faq.question: Q6. Are allowances like HRA provided on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes, dearness allowance, transport allowance, and house rent allowance (if campus accommodation is not available) are provided as applicable to Central Government Employees.

faq.question: Q7. Who is eligible for age relaxations and category certificates?
faq.answer: Candidates belonging to SC, ST, OBC-NCL, EWS, and PwD categories receive age relaxations and reservation benefits as per Government of India norms, subject to submitting valid prescribed certificates.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates shortlisted for the interview?
faq.answer: The Institute conducts scrutiny, shortlisting based on cumulative essential credit points, written tests, presentations of teaching and research seminars, and personal interviews before a duly constituted selection committee.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates apply for more than one faculty position?
faq.answer: Yes, separate applications must be submitted if an applicant is applying for more than one faculty position.
